readerCopy.body: A bigger opportunity can make the next direction feel obvious before the larger version has shown what it will require. When Jupiter conjoins the North Node, expansion and forward movement meet in the same opening, bringing more access, education, travel, visibility, mentorship, or responsibility into view. The opportunity may be excellent while scale hides the cost until the calendar, budget, or workload has already changed. The strongest yes is the one the surrounding life can still support after the excitement becomes ordinary.
